title: MemRiskBench: Trace-Aware Risk-Preserving Evaluation for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.14976v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate memory across sessions, creating sparse but high-impact risks: stale facts, conflicting updates, cross-user leakage, revoked-memory reuse, and constraint decay. Standard aggregate scores hide per-risk failure rates--a model achieving 78% average accuracy may still leak data in 4% of episodes--and benchmark compression preferentially discards the rare high-severity events that distinguish a mostly-working model from one that occasionally causes harm. We present MemRiskBench. The primary contribution is a five-category risk taxonomy (plus one documented, unscored category) operationalized by deterministic trace grounded checks, instantiated as a 120-episode scripted benchmark with full trace logging and no LLM-as-judge on the pass/fail path, evaluated on five locally run quantized instruction-tuned models. translated_title: MemRiskBench：面向长时程LLM智能体的轨迹感知风险保持评估
translated_abstract: 长时程LLM智能体会跨会话累积记忆，由此产生稀疏但高影响的风险：过时事实、冲突更新、跨用户信息泄露、被撤销记忆的重复使用以及约束衰减。标准聚合分数掩盖了各风险项的失败率——一个平均准确率达78%的模型仍可能在4%的情节中泄露数据——而基准压缩会优先丢弃那些罕见的高严重性事件，而这些事件恰恰区分了“基本可用”的模型与“偶尔造成危害”的模型。我们提出了MemRiskBench。其主要贡献是一个五类风险分类法（外加一个已记录但不计分的类别），通过确定性的、基于轨迹的检查来实现，具体实例化为一个包含120个情节的脚本化基准，具有完整的轨迹日志记录，且在通过/失败判定路径上不使用LLM作为评判者，并在五个本地运行的量化指令微调模型上进行了评估。其次，提出了一种风险保持的子集选择器：一种基于确定性轨迹的覆盖约束贪心选择器，用于……
tldr: 提出MemRiskBench基准，通过五类记忆风险分类法和确定性轨迹检查评估长时程LLM智能体，并设计风险保持的子集选择器，避免基准压缩丢弃罕见但高严重性的风险事件。
en_tdlr: MemRiskBench is a trace-aware benchmark with a five-category memory risk taxonomy and deterministic checks for evaluating long-horizon LLM agents, together with a risk-preserving subset selector that prevents benchmark compression from discarding rare but high-severity risk events.
